text:
Eva Chen: quick sync — we need a short, repeatable rule for SI claims on marketplace + HW partner leads. repeating confusion in last week's intake :sweat_smile:
Samir Patel: agreed. saw two SIs both claim same ACV 150k account yesterday. messy.
Jules Martin: from GTM: core ask is 'who owns the demo & next-step' and clear SLA on claiming. can we make it a 48h claim window after intake?
Maya Ortiz: 48h sounds OK, but need required fields before claim: marketplace listing ID (if applicable), customer org domain, evidence of contact (email/meeting), and lead source.
Tom Nguyen: also add territory mapping check — if SI territory != account region, auto-reject claim. we already have a mapping sheet but need programmatic enforcement.
Eva Chen: +1. propose process:
- Intake posts to #partnerships-inbound (bot) with lead payload
- SI has 48h to post a DM to @partnerships-ops with 'SI-claim: <lead id>' and required docs
- If multiple claims, partnerships-ops runs quick triage within next 12h and assigns
Samir Patel: what about hardware partner-generated leads (HW partner refers customer to SI)? they often want priority.
Maya Ortiz: make a priority tier: HW-sourced -> Tier A, Marketplace trial opt-in -> Tier B, Field-sourced -> Tier C. Tier A claims get 24h SLA, others 48h.
Jules Martin: need CRM tagging standard: add tags: `si_claim`, `si_claim_priority= A|B|C`, `si_claim_time` (ISO). This helps downstream automation.
Tom Nguyen: can we add a soft lock in intake form? like a `claimed_by` field that defaults to empty, updated by partnerships-ops or bot when claim accepted. prevents double-assign UI churn.
InfraBot: deploy note: a /claim endpoint can accept POST {lead_id, claimant, proof_url, priority} and will respond with 200/409 based on current lock. planning a small lambda + webhook. ETA 1 week.
Eva Chen: sounds great. last piece — escalation: if claim disputed after assignment (SI A vs SI B), escalate to partnerships leads (Jules + Eva) and set a 48h mediation window. If unresolved, default to field owner.
Samir Patel: examples of 'proof' that count? meeting notes, recorded intro call, contract LOI, or marketplace engagement logs.
Maya Ortiz: add checklist in intake message so claimers can just paste checklist items. reduces back-and-forth.
Jules Martin: ok action items:
- Maya: update intake form with required fields + checklist (due Thu)
- Infra: prototype /claim endpoint + lock behavior (ETA 1w)
- Eva/Jules: write short SOP doc for SI claims and escalation (due next Tue)
- Samir/Tom: run a 1hr alignment w/ top 5 SIs next Wed to walk through new rules
Tom Nguyen: I'll draft an internal FAQ for field engineers about priority tiers.
Maya Ortiz: linking current mapping sheet: https://company.internal/sheets/si-territory-map (useful for enforcement)
Eva Chen: perfect. quick aside — for joint announcements: if an SI is working a lead and wants co-marketing, requiring consent form signed before announce. we'll add a check in SOP.
Jules Martin: :thumbsup: thanks all. if no objections I'll post this as the lightweight policy in Confluence once Maya sends updated form.
Samir Patel: no objections from me. makes ops cleaner.
Tom Nguyen: good to go.
Eva Chen: thanks — closing the thread. please react with :white_check_mark: when you've completed your action.
InfraBot: reminder scheduled: check /claim prototype health in 7 days.
